objective: Research the next improvement after head-only and pairwise-only oracle action-value finetuning failed to improve ranking.
conclusion: Pairwise ranking is the right objective family, but applying it only to reward/return heads is too weak and may optimize the wrong score carrier. The next experiment should jointly train action_encoder, dynamics, reward/return, and hard_reduction on pairwise ranking of the actual planner score, preferably hybrid_pred or its differentiable equivalent.
recommended_next_command: $autoresearch plan Joint-train action_encoder/dynamics/reward/hard_reduction on oracle pairwise planner-score ranking instead of head-only reward finetune.

promote_if: hybrid_pred Spearman improves by at least 0.05 on held-out labeled subckt val
negative_top1_rate does not worsen on held-out labeled subckt val
top1_regret does not worsen on held-out labeled subckt val
reject_if: negative_top1_rate worsens on held-out labeled subckt val
hybrid_pred Spearman decreases materially on held-out labeled subckt val
